lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC special meeting Wednesday, where commissioners will consider changing the AMI income limits on deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park — a move that could quietly shift who qualifies for local housing. Also Wednesday, the county Planning Commission takes up three proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. Over in Ridgway, the town council meets Tuesday with the Gold Mountain Fire's aftermath squarely on the agenda.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire-affected communities.
